BiblicalUsage: Gathering is what God does with His people and what His people do at His word: Samuel gathered all Israel to Mizpeh to pray, Ahab gathered the prophets of Baal to Carmel. David prayed that God would gather His scattered people and deliver them from the heathen.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gathering is God's answer to scattering, and the prayer of the exile is still mine: gather us together, and deliver us. When the people come together at His word, He meets them there, and the gathering itself becomes the worship.
